description:
Title formats of the last 90 days with their median multiple, share over 1.5x, adoption
    and examples, ordered by the Wilson lower bound of that share (computed_from). Formats with at
    least 8 measured videos from 3 channels (each shows measured beside videos); include_small lists
    down to 3 from 2. Free. Same as GET /v1/formats.
name: list_formats
